options.description: Plumb gathers the requirements, decisions, examples and test states on the topic. The agent writes from that set, and the study keeps links to those records, so it's marked out of date when they change and `explain` points to it. A topic with no records says so.
options.label: Built from records, traced (Recommended)

options.description: The agent still writes freely, but must name the records it drew on; those links mark it out of date when they change. Plumb doesn't gather the material.
options.label: Traced only

options.description: Keep studies freehand; only the depth and acceptance rules apply.
options.label: Free as today

payload.question: Should a study be grounded in plumb's records, like the rest of plumb?
